tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and elevated urine glucose, with low specific gravity. Urine culture confirms >100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella pneumoniae. Findings are consistent with a urinary tract infection, likely complicated by glycosuria (possible diabetes or renal glycosuria). No casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
